finding: Single unpaginated wear_logs query could truncate history at the Data API response cap
change: Owner-filtered pages of 250 ordered by date DESC and id DESC; all-or-nothing replacement and auth revision guards

cases: complete ID sequence and item mapping

limitations: Controlled query responses, not a hosted 1001-row wear-history run
Offset pagination does not provide a database snapshot across concurrent writes
No native long-history rendering, export or production deployment
